title: Unnaiththane
desc: A Christian Zumba instructor and a Hindu upper-caste woman bond over dance and fall in love. But their relationship faces struggles as they face discrimination due to their caste.

title: Kathanayagan
desc: A revenue inspector falls in love with a girl but faces problems due to his cowardliness. He is compelled to find a way to prove himself to her father, who wants her to marry a brave man.

title: Nenjamellam Pala Vannam
desc: Two unemployed brothers who do not get along well due to their contrasting natures try to marry the women they love before an accident changes their lives.

desc: A minister on his deathbed reveals to an MLA the whereabouts of billions in cash that he has stashed away. However, the minister's relatives are vexed when the MLA loses his memory in an accident.

title: Mannarkudi Veeran
desc: Siddhartha, a courageous District Commissioner, goes against a notorious local politician.

title: Oru Nodi
desc: When a man goes missing under perplexing circumstances, a police inspector embarks on a quest to investigate the case, exposing a concealed network of political corruption.

desc: Heartbroken on being back-stabbed by his childhood friend, Raju, an influential man, runs away from his hometown, Kotha. Soon, to bring back order in the town, a police officer plots a plan.
Sathya, a young policeman, curses his luck when he gets posted in a control room. However, his life takes an unusual turn after the 100th call he overhears.

title: Yaaro Ival
desc: Kalyan, a blind chef, regains his sight to uncover the truth behind Vennela's sudden disappearance, leading to unexpected twists and shocking revelations.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Tej I Love You
desc: Tej, a young man, gets banished from his family for breaking his sister's marriage. He moves to London where he falls in love with a beautiful girl, Nandini.

title: Mandela
desc: In a small village, two political parties compete in the local elections and are ready to win at any cost. In a twist of fate, the single deciding vote comes down to a small-time barber.

title: Akshara
desc: A girl from a poor family joins a reputed college but falls into the trap of the college chairman and is sent to jail.

title: Kumki
desc: Bomman, a mahout, and his elephant are assigned to protect the crops of a hill tribe from a rogue elephant. However, his life takes a turn when he falls in love with the village leader's daughter.

title: Visithiran
desc: A retired policeman known for his investigative skills grieves the death of his wife. However, things take a turn when he gets embroiled in a human trafficking case.

title: Pathu Endrathukulla
desc: A driving instructor is tasked to deliver Shakeela, a young woman, to a landlord in Mussoorie. But soon, he finds out that her life is in danger and decides to be her saviour.
